name: kymostudio
description: Bediene die lokale KymoStudio-Desktop-Instanz über MCP mit Vorrang für Messwerterfassung und Trace-Aufzeichnung.

interface.longDescription: Operating guidance for a separately installed local KymoStudio desktop and MCP adapter. Discover measurement sources, configure charts and workspaces, follow capture/replay and export jobs, and respect acquisition limits. Requires a running MCP-enabled KymoStudio instance and a separately configured local connection. Intended for local Claude Code and Codex clients. Core workflows require desktop application access; cloud-only clients need a separately supported connection architecture. Measurement results returned through the client may be shared with its model provider.
defaultPrompt: Help me connect my local KymoStudio installation.
Check my measurement sources and capture status.
Export retained samples to my granted local folder.
